perf.notes: NumPy uses the closed-form equations of motion; JAX derives them by autodiff (mass matrix + mixed Hessian per step).
NumPy uses the closed-form 2x2 Bloch Hamiltonian; jaxphys assembles H(k) from the hopping list.
NumPy side: SciPy sparse assembly + spsolve (SuperLU); jaxphys: dense block-tridiagonal elimination with lax.scan.
NumPy side finds neighbours with SciPy's compiled cKDTree.
Different RNG streams and update orders (checkerboard vs random site): mean energy per spin compared statistically (5 sigma, blocked errors).
Compared statistically against a textbook (stack-based) Wolff implementation (5 sigma).

scaling.kernel: EMGrid 2D FDTD (100x100), batch of source frequencies

accuracy.name: Energy error over long runs: symplectic vs RK4 (Kepler, e=0.5)
accuracy.criterion: leapfrog/yoshida4 max error in 2nd half <= 1.5x 1st half (bounded); rk4 2nd half > 1.5x 1st half (secular drift)

accuracy.name: Convergence order vs dt
accuracy.criterion: |measured - expected| <= 0.3 (log-log least-squares fit over the three finest dt with error > 1e-10, i.e. above round-off)

accuracy.name: Schrodinger: norm conservation + free Gaussian wavepacket
accuracy.criterion: norm deviation < 1e-10; free packet: psi relative L2 error vs the exact solution < 1e-8 at t=5 on every grid (V = 0, so the split-operator step is exact in time and the FFT grid is spectrally accurate)

accuracy.name: Ising critical temperature (Binder cumulant crossing, Metropolis)
accuracy.criterion: largest-size-pair crossing (cubic fits of U_L(T)) within 3 jackknife errors + 1% (finite-size allowance) of Onsager T_c; Wolff and Metropolis mean energies agree within 5 sigma (blocked errors) at T = 2.0 and 3.0

accuracy.name: LBM plane channel vs analytic
accuracy.criterion: (a) shear-mode decay-rate error < 5% at every width; (b) steady driven channel: relative mass change < 1e-4 over the last snapshot interval, every cross-section carries the inflow to 1e-4, profile within 0.5% of the parabola, dp/dx within 5% of -12 mu u_mean / H^2

accuracy.name: jax.grad through simulate() vs central finite differences

rows.case: HamiltonianSystem: d q(10) / d k (anharmonic, 10000 steps)
NBody: d sum|x(1)|^2 / d vx0 (N=8, 2000 steps)
LagrangianSystem pendulum: d theta(5) / d g (rk4, 5000 steps)

accuracy.name: Compressible Euler: Sod shock tube vs exact Riemann solution
accuracy.criterion: density L1 error < 5e-3 at 400 cells and decreasing under refinement (discontinuities limit the order to <= 1)

accuracy.name: FDFD line source vs 2D Green's function (Hankel H0)
accuracy.criterion: max relative error < 2% at 30 points per wavelength, second-order convergence (order within 0.5 of 2)

accuracy.name: SPH standing sound wave (quarter period vs L / 4 c0)
accuracy.criterion: kinetic-energy minimum within 3% of L / (4 c0); total momentum < 1e-12; energy change < 1e-3 of the initial kinetic energy
